name: taskforge
description: KOZMOS Taskforge: a live kanban of the session's tasks. TodoWrite lists and TaskCreate/TaskUpdate tasks fall into Pending, In progress and Done columns with the active form, time in the column and the owning agent, under a progress bar. /taskforge toggles the sidebar.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Taskforge sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).
